title: weekly_momentum_v2 — operations
description: Trade proposals, approvals, orders and audit trail. Positions and balances are NOT here: those are read live from IBKR.

proposals.description: What the strategy wants to do. A proposal is not an order.

approvals.description: Append-only record of your decisions. The override column is the one to watch.

orders.description: Broker lifecycle. broker_order_id is IBKR's; IBKR is the source of truth.

signals.description: One row per symbol per run. Reproducible from the parquet cache.

runs.description: Audit spine. config_hash pins the exact parameters each run used.

journal.description: Your weekly notes. The 15 minutes that decides whether this works.

parameter_changes.description: The 5-change budget from spec section 12. Once exhausted, the spec is frozen.

system_state.description: Kill switch. trading_enabled = 0 means no orders are built, full stop.

position_state.description: The one thing IBKR cannot tell us: highest close since entry, for the laddered trailing stop.

weekly_review.title: Weekly review — everything awaiting your decision
weekly_review.description: Start here every Saturday. Exits first, then entries.
weekly_review.sql: SELECT action, symbol, reason, rank, qty, ref_price, est_value, risk_status, ai_veto, reason_detail, proposal_id FROM v_pending_approval ORDER BY CASE action WHEN 'SELL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rank

top_ranked.title: Current rankings
top_ranked.description: Latest signal run. Rank 1-10 are entry candidates; above 16 triggers an exit.
top_ranked.sql: SELECT rank, symbol, sector, close, momentum, vol, score, atr, regime FROM v_current_signals LIMIT 30

adherence.title: Adherence — are you following your own system?
adherence.description: Three consecutive weeks of overrides is a kill criterion (spec section 14). A manual risk dial change counts as an override.
adherence.sql: SELECT week, SUM(decisions) AS decisions, SUM(overrides) AS overrides, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(overrides) / SUM(decisions), 1) AS override_pct FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', decided_at) AS week, COUNT(*) AS decisions, SUM(override) AS overrides FROM approvals GROUP BY week UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', changed_at) AS week, COUNT(*) AS decisions, COUNT(*) AS overrides FROM risk_dial_changes GROUP BY week) GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 26

overrides.title: Override log
overrides.description: Every time you went against the system, and why.
overrides.sql: SELECT decided_at, symbol, action, reason, decision, override_reason, est_value FROM v_override_log LIMIT 100

drawdown.title: Equity and drawdown
drawdown.description: Halt triggers at 20% drawdown and requires a manual restart.
drawdown.sql: SELECT as_of, ROUND(net_liquidation, 2) AS net_liq, ROUND(cash, 2) AS cash, n_positions, ROUND(100.0 * drawdown, 2) AS drawdown_pct, CASE WHEN drawdown >= 0.20 THEN 'HALT' WHEN drawdown >= 0.15 THEN 'WARN' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM equity_curve ORDER BY as_of DESC LIMIT 60

run_health.title: Run health
run_health.description: Did the pipeline run, did the data gate pass, what came out.
run_health.sql: SELECT started_at, run_type, status, data_gate, data_coverage, staleness_days, n_proposals, n_orders, halt_reason FROM v_run_health LIMIT 40

open_orders.title: Orders not yet terminal
open_orders.description: Anything still in flight. Never assume a submitted order filled.
open_orders.sql: SELECT submitted_at, symbol, action, quantity, limit_price, status, filled_quantity, avg_fill_price, error FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('FILLED','CANCELLED','REJECTED','EXPIRED') ORDER BY submitted_at DESC

fills_vs_reference.title: Execution quality — fills vs reference price
fills_vs_reference.description: Slippage against the price the strategy assumed. Compare to the 5bps backtest assumption.
fills_vs_reference.sql: SELECT o.symbol, o.action, o.submitted_at, ROUND(p.reference_price, 2) AS ref_price, ROUND(o.avg_fill_price, 2) AS fill, ROUND(10000.0 * (o.avg_fill_price - p.reference_price) / p.reference_price * CASE o.action WHEN 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END, 1) AS slippage_bps FROM orders o JOIN proposals p ON p.proposal_id = o.proposal_id WHERE o.status = 'FILLED' ORDER BY o.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 100

ai_veto_activity.title: AI veto layer — what it flagged
ai_veto_activity.description: Veto only. It cannot select or size anything.
ai_veto_activity.sql: SELECT reviewed_at, symbol, status, flag, severity, reasoning FROM ai_reviews WHERE flag = 1 OR status != 'ok' ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC LIMIT 50

parameter_budget.title: Parameter change budget
parameter_budget.description: 5 changes total. Each one spends out-of-sample validity.
parameter_budget.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parameter_changes) AS used, 5 AS budget, 5 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parameter_changes) AS remaining
